{{Quote|They say I am lost, but I am not lost! The spores... they show me the truth!|Doctor Spears|<ref name="iPresume">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Dr. Spears, I presume?|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>}}
'''Spears''', briefly known as '''Doctor SPORES''',  was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] who was present at the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] in the [[Sporefall]] area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Sporefall">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Sporefall]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> He was the last scientist to arrive at the Sporefall forward camp. [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Edreck]] noted that Spears might not have had an adequate education on the risks of the prolonged exposure to the [[Fungus/Legends|spores]] of the area.<ref name="datapadLog">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Datapad "Progress Log: New Entry", found in the forward [[Sporefall]] camp on [[Dantooine/Legends|Datooine]]}}</ref>

Searching for an entrance into the interior of the ''[[Jannimak]]''{{'s}} wreckage, Doctor Spears wandered off and lost communication contact with Professor Edreck and his team.<ref name="datapadLog" /> He was found later by [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors, lost and confused. The spore exposure affected his mind, and Spears developed a [[Multiple personality disorder|second personality]].<ref name="iPresume" />

=="Doctor SPORES"==
{{Quote|At last, my true nature is revealed!|Doctor Spears as "Doctor SPORES"|<ref name="iPresume" />}}
[[File:SPORESisBorn-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|The emergence of the second personality of Doctor Spears]]
Under the mind-altering influence of poisonous [[Fungus/Legends|spores]], Spears named himself "''Doctor SPORES''" and attacked [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors looking for him. He was aided by other creatures under the spore influence, primarily [[Makrin creeper|makrin]] young.<ref name="iPresume" /> When defeated and temporally cured by GSI contractors with an Anti-Microbial Injection,<ref name="injection">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|No Spies Allowed!|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], naming spore-cure as an Anti-Microbial Injection}}</ref> Spears went back to the camp, but didn't make it.<ref name="Sporefall" /> He resurfaced once again as Doctor SPORES, taking control of a section of ''[[Jannimak]]'s'' wreckage, and activating a local [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding field]] device to protect himself from the GSI contractors, still searching for him. Aided by a giant [[Barbed ginx|ginx]] and a [[yara]], as well as several ''Jannimak'' [[Caretaker Probe droid|Caretaker droids]], Doctor was defeated again, and quickly run off, claiming that he "made a huge breakthrough".<ref name="call">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|They Call me Doctor Spores|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> However, once again, spores got control over him, and Spears's spore-induced alter ego returned. The third time, SPORES got defeated at the same spot in the adjacent to [[Sporefall]] wing of the ship.<ref name="return">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Return of Doctor SPORES!|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Doctor Spears was described by Professor [[Edreck]] as fearless and intrepid but not exactly "forthcoming".<ref name="datapadLog" /> Spears avoided any responsibility for his actions as Doctor SPORES, not even acknowledging his personality shift when cured.<ref name="iPresume" /><ref name="call" /><ref name="return" />

==Behind the scenes==
Doctor Spears first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> He is a central figure in the Doctor SPORES dynamic quest chain; while under the influence of spores he changes into a 3d model of Doctor [[Armaxa]].<ref name="iPresume" /><ref name="call" /><ref name="return" />
